meaning:
ἴασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἰάομαι), [in LXX chiefly for מַרְפֵּא ;]
a healing, cure: Act.4:22, 30; pl., Luk.13:32.†
SYN.: see: θεραπεία, 2; ἴαμα, 2 (AS)

elsewhere.note: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.
For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
